battle.name: 忽必烈與阿里不哥之戰
battle.theater: 蒙古高原和林與怯綠連河戰線
battle.brief: 中統元年（1260）春，忽必烈於開平即位為大汗，阿里不哥其後在和林被推為大汗，汗位之爭遂成內戰。十字弩在此役多由漢軍與西域降軍攜帶，用於近城射擊、隘口封鎖與守城；草原野戰仍以蒙古弓刀為主。戰事自怯綠連河失利起，至1264年阿里不哥歸順而罷。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 這是一場發生在蒙古帝國本部的內戰，交戰的兩方同出於一個家族，兵源構成卻幾乎相反。阿里不哥一方以和林為根基：汗廷的本部貴族、札剌亦兒與各千戶長為骨幹，兵眾多為蒙古本部牧民，能野戰而缺攻城器械，也沒有燕京、中都一線的賦稅與糧秣；其勢力範圍止於蒙古高原北部的草場，以及西域的伊犁河谷與天山南北諸城。忽必烈一方以開平行宮和燕京為中樞：除了本部漢地軍、探馬赤，還有契丹、漢人、畏兀兒、哈剌契丹等編制，攻城用的配重投石機、撞車與雲梯多出西域及漢地工匠之手，糧餉自中都、山東、陝西沿驛道與河運接濟——兵源雜而攻城手段齊備，是典型的以漢地補蒙古、以器械補騎兵。忽必烈在制度上還先得一步：1238 年他已受命總領漠南漢地軍國庶事，1251 年即位，阿里不哥直到 1260 年才在和林以忽里勒台取得大汗名號。於是全場的基本盤很清楚：阿里不哥握有名分與本部人望，忽必烈握有錢糧、人口與器械。
countriesEn: This was a civil war fought in the heart of the Mongol empire, and the two sides came out of the same family even though their military composition was almost the exact mirror image of one another. Ariq Böke's side rested on Karakorum. The tribal aristocracy of the steppe court, the jarachi, and the commanders of the thousands formed its backbone; most of his men were Mongol herders, superb in the open field but short of siege equipment, and he had neither the taxes nor the grain of the Yanjing and Zhongdu lines. His reach covered the pastures of the northern Mongolian plateau and, to the west, the valley of the Ili and the cities north and south of the Tian Shan. Kublai's side was centred on the summer capital at Kaiping and on Dadu. Alongside his native Mongol and tanmachi levies he fielded Khitan, Chinese, Uyghur and Qarluq formations, and the counterweight trebuchets, rams and scaling ladders with which he assaulted walls were largely built by Uyghur and Chinese artisans. His grain came by relay road and river out of Zhongdu, Shandong and Guanzhong: a mixed manpower backed by complete siege equipment, in effect Mongols supplemented by the Chinese lands and cavalry supplemented by machines. Kublai also held an institutional advantage. He had been given charge of military and civil affairs south of the desert in 1238 and had been enthroned in 1251, while Ariq Böke did not acquire the title of Great Khan by kurultai at Karakorum until 1260. The division of assets behind the whole war was therefore plain: Ariq Böke had legitimacy and the loyalty of the tribes, Kublai had money, grain, people and machines.
people: 留下姓名的，多數在忽必烈這邊。忽必烈是全場的當事人：1238 年總領漠南漢地軍國庶事，1251 年即位，1260 年中統元年三月在開平正式稱大汗，四月自燕京率師北上。他以漢地財賦養兵，用西域工匠造攻城器械，把草原部眾與漢軍編在一起，這一套做法後來成為元朝的立國之本。阿里不哥是另一方的主帥：為人篤厚，在本部貴族中人望極高，1260 年在和林被推為大汗，卻缺少處理漢地與西域的經驗，屢次在軍事得手之後錯過追擊的時機。他的部將渾都海是怯綠連河之戰的關鍵人物——正是他不滿和議而擅自追擊忽必烈，才把一場尚未對阿里不哥不利的會戰推向全面崩潰。阿里不哥的弟弟別里古台最終倒向忽必烈，成為他陣營上裂開的缺口。察合台系那邊，阿八兒是受阿里不哥庇蔭的察合台汗，1261 年被拔都之子八剌所殺，部下潰散，多歸忽必烈；拔都本人於 1262 年病故，其弟斡難兀闍尼接掌欽察，1263 年在科布齊、鐵山一線追上阿里不哥並將其主力打散。窩闊台之子貴由早死，海都成為窩闊台系的領袖，並在山東李璮之亂中與阿里不哥遙相呼應。漢地方面，伯顏、廉希憲、董文炳、張禧各領一路；真金以太子身分在軍中歷事，是後來的裕宗。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to Kublai's side. Kublai was himself the principal party: given charge of the military and civil affairs of the Chinese lands in 1238, enthroned in 1251, and in the third month of the first year of the Zhongtong era (1260) proclaimed Great Khan at Kaiping, he marched north out of Dadu in the fourth month. He fed his army on the revenue of the Chinese lands, had siege engines built by Uyghur artisans, and welded the steppe levies together with Chinese troops; that combination later became the foundation of the Yuan state. Ariq Böke commanded the other side. A man of unyielding character who enjoyed enormous prestige among the Mongol aristocracy, he was chosen Great Khan at Karakorum in 1260, yet he was deficient in any experience of governing the Chinese lands or the western regions, and more than once let a favourable moment pass after a successful action. His commander Chundalai was the decisive figure at the battle of the Khere River: unwilling to accept the truce that had already been agreed, he pursued Kublai's withdrawing force and turned an engagement that had not yet turned against Ariq Böke into a general collapse. Ariq Böke's brother Berke finally went over to Kublai, and the defection opened a crack in his camp. In the Chagatai line, Abqa, the khan who had taken shelter under Ariq Böke, was killed in 1261 by Bala, a son of Batu; his scattered followers went over to Kublai in large numbers. Batu himself died in 1262, and his brother Urancjiad inherited the Kipchak host; in 1263 Urancjiad caught up with Ariq Böke around Köböchi and the Iron Mountains and destroyed his main force. The son of Ögedei, Güyük, had died young and Kaidu headed the Ögedeid line, staying in touch with Ariq Böke from afar during the revolt of Li Tan in Shandong. On the Chinese side Baiyan, Lian Xixian, Dong Wenbing and Zhang Xi each led a column, and the heir apparent Zhenjin served in the army and later became Yuzong.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩，在這場戰爭裡的位置相當特殊：它不是蒙古騎兵的主兵器，卻是攻城與近距離火力裡最靠前的一環。蒙古平原上的交鋒仍靠蒙古弓——一種以木、角、筋合成的反曲複合弓，張力大、射速快，騎在馬上便能反覆張弦，開弓的動作不必停下前進；刀、矛與札甲、鎖子甲配合使用，騎兵靠速度與陣形取勝。弩的位置因此在別處：漢軍的蹶張弩與小弩、西域降軍攜帶的各式手弩，主要用於近城射擊、隘口封鎖、攻壘時壓制城頭，以及守城時填補弓箭手的射界與射程。攻城序列中，與弩並列的是配重投石機、撞車、雲梯、橐駝式的攻城車，以及用於破壞城基的挖掘器具；毒煙火桶與火藥拋射物則用來對付密集列陣的守軍。漢地軍另備有能射數百步的強弩（宋人所稱的神臂弓，實為大型弓弩），是遠程火力的一端。運輸方面，騎兵自備肉乾、乳酪與馬奶，行軍可支應數十日不作屯田；攻城大軍卻必須靠中都、山東的糧船與車隊接濟，弩手與砲手多乘車，步卒與器械同列。卡面所說的「城牆上比長弓可靠、野戰裡比長弓脆弱」，正是此役弓弩分工的寫照。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card occupied a peculiar place in this war: it was never the principal arm of the Mongol cavalry, yet it stood at the very front of the siege and close-range firepower. Open fighting on the Mongolian plains still turned on the Mongol bow, a recurved composite of wood, horn and sinew with high draw weight and a fast rate of fire, which a rider could cock again and again without breaking the gallop; knives, spears, lamellar and mail armour went with it, and the cavalry won on speed and formation. The crossbow therefore belonged elsewhere. The foot-tensioned crossbows and hand crossbows of the Chinese levies, and the various hand crossbows carried by troops surrendered from the west, served for shooting at close range against walls, for sealing passes and defiles, for pinning defenders on the ramparts during an assault, and for filling out the range and arc of the archers when a city was being defended. In the assault column the crossbow stood beside counterweight trebuchets, battering rams, scaling ladders and camel-borne siege towers, together with the digging tools used to work at the foot of a wall; smoke-filled fire pots and powder projectiles were used against defenders massed in a narrow place. The Chinese armies also carried powerful crossbows capable of shooting several hundred paces, the so-called divine-arm crossbow of the Song, which formed the far end of the range. On the logistics side, cavalrymen carried dried meat, dried cheese and mare's milk and could live for dozens of days without foraging, but a besieging host had to be fed by the grain boats and wagon trains of Zhongdu and Shandong, with crossbowmen and gunners travelling in wagons and infantry and equipment marching in the same column. The card's remark that on a wall it is more reliable than a long bow while in the field it is more fragile than one is exactly the division of labour between bow and crossbow in this war.
tactics: 這場內戰的戰術，多數時間是蒙古式的機動與消耗的對撞。忽必烈自燕京、中都北上，沿途以漢地騎兵與探馬赤構成偵察網，企圖不待整備便直取和林；阿里不哥則背靠杭愛山北麓的草場與和林城，把牧場與水源握在手中，等對方進入自己熟悉的冬季牧地再行反擊。怯綠連河之戰裡，忽必烈先遣使者約和，阿里不哥已受諾，部將渾都海卻不肯罷手，驟然追擊；蒙古騎兵在會戰中往往採假退誘敵、再以兩翼包抄的老套，兩翼一旦合攏敗退，崩潰就難以收拾，這一役忽必烈失利，追出數十里才收住陣腳。得利的一方沒有追：阿里不哥沒有乘勝南下燕京，讓對方得以回師整頓，兵敗而國勢不崩，此後的僵局大半由此而來。攻城方面，蒙古人並不迷信硬撞：遠程迂迴、守城消耗、斷糧與焚燒草場、封鎖隘口都是常用手段；配重投石機的射程與轟擊密度決定了圍城能否速下，弩手則守在近處壓制城頭與缺口。1260 年代初，西域工匠造出的攻城器械在河西走廊與天山南北反覆使用，阿里不哥系的據點多數不是被強攻下的，而是被斷了外援、圍到內部自行崩解。
tacticsEn: For most of its length the tactics of this civil war were a collision between Mongol mobility and Mongol endurance. Kublai marched north out of Dadu and Zhongdu, throwing out a screen of Chinese cavalry and tanmachi scouts along the route, hoping to reach Karakorum before the army was fully assembled. Ariq Böke sat with his back to the pastures north of the Khangai mountains and to the city of Karakorum, holding the grazing and the water in his hands and waiting for his opponent to come into the winter pastures he knew. At the battle of the Khere River Kublai first sent an envoy to propose a truce; Ariq Böke had already assented, but his commander Chundalai would not let it rest and pursued without orders. Mongol cavalry in a pitched meeting of this kind habitually feigned retreat to draw the enemy out and then closed the wings to envelop; once the two wings closed on a beaten force, collapse was hard to arrest, and Kublai was defeated here, rallying only after a pursuit of several dozen li. The side that had the better of it did not pursue. Ariq Böke did not ride south into Yanjing to exploit the victory, and so his opponent was able to pull his army back, refit and return. His army was defeated but his position was not broken, and the stalemate that followed was largely a consequence of that choice. In siege work the Mongols were not dogmatic about storming: turning movements, wearing down the defenders, cutting supplies and burning pasture, and sealing the passes were all standard practice. The range and the rate of fire of the counterweight trebuchet decided whether a siege could be brought to a quick end, while the crossbowmen held close in to pin the ramparts and the breaches. In the early 1260s the siege engines built by Uyghur artisans were used again and again along the Hexi corridor and north and south of the Tian Shan, and most of Ariq Böke's strongholds did not fall to assault at all: they were cut off from help and surrounded until they collapsed from within.
data: 可以核的數字不多，以下幾項是史書與地圖都能對上的。時間：1260 年三月忽必烈在開平即位，阿里不哥同年三月至五月間在和林被推為大汗；同年五月兩軍戰於怯綠連河，忽必烈失利；1261 年察合台汗阿八兒被殺，其部眾轉附忽必烈；1262 年山東李璮之亂牽制忽必烈兵力，同年拔都病故；1263 年斡難兀闍尼在科布齊、鐵山一線追上阿里不哥大破之；1264 年阿里不哥在納麻烏歸順，1265 年病歿於西域。整場內戰自 1260 年算到 1264 年，約四年。距離：和林（今蒙古國哈拉和林）至開平（今內蒙古正藍旗）約九百公里，至燕京約七百公里——忽必烈第一次北征要走的就是這樣一條路，數年後阿里不哥大軍西撤的線路也在同一量級。兵力：現存史料只給量級，不給名冊；阿里不哥的本部兵眾常被寫作數萬，但作戰時往往只能徵集一翼，忽必烈一方則以漢地軍與本部騎兵混編，總數同樣沒有可靠記載。損失：《元史》等只說怯綠連河一役「軍敗」而無確數，1263 年鐵山之戰阿里不哥僅以身免，可確知其主力全潰。糧秣：蒙古騎兵可自備數十日肉乾與乳酪，攻城大軍卻要靠中都與山東的漕運，一旦運輸線被切斷，圍城便自動解體。
dataEn: Few figures survive that can be checked, and the following are the ones that both the histories and the maps support. On time: in the third month of 1260 Kublai was proclaimed at Kaiping, and between the third and fifth months of the same year Ariq Böke was chosen Great Khan at Karakorum; in the fifth month the two armies fought at the Khere River and Kublai was beaten; in 1261 the Chagatai khan Abqa was killed and his people transferred themselves to Kublai; in 1262 the revolt of Li Tan in Shandong tied down Kublai's forces, and in the same year Batu died of illness; in 1263 Urancjiad caught Ariq Böke around Köböchi and the Iron Mountains and destroyed him; in 1264 Ariq Böke submitted at Nama and he died of illness in the west in 1265. Measured from 1260 to 1264, the civil war ran about four years. On distance: Karakorum, today's Kharkhorin in Mongolia, lies roughly nine hundred kilometres from Kaiping, in today's Zhenglan Banner of Inner Mongolia, and about seven hundred kilometres from Yanjing. That was the length of the road Kublai's first northern march had to cover, and the line along which Ariq Böke's host later withdrew to the west was of the same order. On strength: the surviving sources give orders of magnitude rather than rolls, and no muster returns. Ariq Böke's tribal host is commonly written up as several tens of thousands, though in the field he could often bring only one wing to the battle, while Kublai's force was a mixture of Chinese levies and Mongol cavalry whose total is equally unrecorded. On losses: the History of Yuan and its like say only that the army was defeated at the Khere River, without a figure, while in the fighting at the Iron Mountains in 1263 Ariq Böke escaped with his life alone, so that the destruction of his main force is certain. On supply: Mongol cavalry could feed themselves for dozens of days on dried meat and dairy, but a besieging host depended on the grain traffic of Zhongdu and Shandong; once that line was cut, a siege dissolved of its own accord.
cause: 打起來的根由，要從蒙古帝國的汗位繼承說起。1238 年忽必烈受命總領漠南漢地軍國庶事，長期經營燕雲、漢地與漠南，1251 年即位；此後漢地財賦、漢人官僚與畏兀兒、西域工匠一一歸於他的掌握，在崇尚馬上征伐的本部貴族看來，這是把帝國的方向改了。1246 年在哈剌河召開的庫魯台選汗中，忽必烈與阿里不哥都曾抵制阿剌黑家族的後裔，使貴由當選，兩人之間的不和由此積下。1257 年蒙哥汗死於釣魚城，帝國一時無大汗；阿里不哥守在和林不肯南下，忽必烈則在開平、燕京一線接管漢地，兩邊的差距越拉越大。1260 年春，開平與和林的兩次即位把名分之爭推到明面：阿里不哥有本部人望與正統之名，忽必烈有半壁江山與全部的錢糧。真正的爆點其實在 1260 年夏天——忽必烈在怯綠連河打了敗仗，卻沒有垮，反倒證明他有能力再來一次；阿里不哥沒有追，於是雙方從「誰是真正的大汗」退化成「誰能把對方耗死」的消耗戰。
causeEn: The root of the fighting lies in the succession of the Mongol empire. In 1238 Kublai was given charge of the military and civil affairs south of the desert and spent years building up the Yanyun, the Chinese lands and the southern steppe; he was enthroned in 1251, and from then on the revenues of the Chinese lands, Chinese officials and Uyghur and western craftsmen came into his hands one by one, which to the aristocracy of the steppe, accustomed to campaigning on horseback, meant that the empire was being turned in a new direction. At the kurultai held on the Qara River in 1246, Kublai and Ariq Böke had both refused the descendants of the line of Alaqaid, and Güyük was elected in consequence; the bad blood between the two men dates from that business. In 1257 Möngke died at Diaoyu, and the empire was left without a Great Khan. Ariq Böke stayed at Karakorum and would not come south, while Kublai took over the Chinese lands at Kaiping and Yanjing, and the distance between the two men grew wider by the year. In the spring of 1260 the two proclamations, at Kaiping and at Karakorum, brought the dispute over precedence into the open: Ariq Böke had the prestige of the tribes and the title of legitimacy, Kublai had half the empire and all its money and grain. The real flashpoint came in the summer of that year. Kublai was beaten at the Khere River, but he did not break; the defeat instead proved that he could come again, and since Ariq Böke did not pursue, the contest degenerated from the question of who was the true Great Khan into a war of attrition in which the only question was who could wear the other out.
impact: 這場內戰決定了蒙古帝國往後百年的形狀。1264 年阿里不哥歸順之後，帝國大汗的名分歸於忽必烈，但實際權力並未統一：西部以拔都的欽察汗國為中心，窩闊台系的金帳汗國控制俄羅草原，察合台汗國佔伊犁河谷與中亞，而忽必烈自己只握有漠南、漢地與西域的一部分——大汗與眾汗並立，帝國實際上一分為四。忽必烈用自己的辦法在東方立國：1268 年取《易經》大哉乾元之義建國號「元」，1271 年正式定「大元」，次年滅南宋。與此同時，窩闊台系的爭端並未了結，海都自 1268 年起在西北挑起戰端，拉攏中亞的察合台諸王，1301 年被真金與諸王合力打敗；乃顏之亂又牽動東北。帝國的分裂使得東西兩側各自求援於外部：西域的伊利汗國與元朝拉攏歐洲的基督教國家，海都則向帖木兒一系靠攏，這條線一直延到十五世紀。回到兵器上，十字弩在元軍中並未退場：漢軍把它固定在守城與攻壘的序列裡，蒙古騎兵在進攻中仍然用弓，兩者搭配的格局一直延續到明代邊軍與北方諸鎮的裝備之中。
impactEn: This civil war fixed the shape of the Mongol empire for the century that followed. After Ariq Böke's submission in 1264 the title of Great Khan belonged to Kublai, but the actual power was not unified: the west centred on Batu's Kipchak realm, the Ögedeid Golden Horde held the Russian steppe, the Chagatai khanate occupied the valley of the Ili and Central Asia, and Kublai himself kept only the southern steppe, the Chinese lands and part of the west. Great Khan and subject khans stood side by side, and the empire was in fact divided into four. Kublai built his own state in the east: he took the title of Yuan from the great beginning of the creative in the Yijing in 1268, fixed the name Great Yuan in 1271, and destroyed the Southern Song in the following year. The quarrel of the Ögedeid line was not settled, and from 1268 Kaidu raised war in the north-west, drawing the Chagatai princes of Central Asia onto his side, until he was defeated in 1301 by Zhenjin and the princes acting together; the revolt of the Nayan troubled the north-east in turn. The division of the empire meant that each half sought support abroad: the Ilkhanate in the west and Yuan China courted the Christian powers of Europe, while Kaidu leaned towards the line of the Tamids, a strand that ran on into the fifteenth century. Returning to the weapon, the crossbow did not leave Yuan service. The Chinese levies fixed it in the sequence for defending walls and assaulting fortifications, while the Mongol cavalry kept to the bow in the attack, and that division of labour between bow and crossbow continued into the equipment of the Ming frontier garrisons and the northern towns.
result: 結果是忽必烈勝，但勝得並不乾淨。怯綠連河的敗仗沒有讓他垮掉，反倒讓他看清本部與漢地必須合在一起用；阿里不哥在有利的形勢下沒有追擊，把一場可以速決的戰爭拖成四年的消耗，最後在西部與欽察、察合台諸部的夾擊下喪失全部部眾。1264 年，阿里不哥遣使請和，自西域納麻烏歸順；此後朝廷對他厚加撫綏，他於 1265 年病歿。汗位之爭至此結束，忽必烈成為蒙古帝國唯一的大汗，但這一個頭銜背後的帝國已經裂成四塊：漠南與漢地在元廷手中，欽察、察合台、窩闊台三家各據一方，各不相屬。對兵器而言，這四年是一場大規模的實用考驗：弩在攻守兩端的效率被反覆驗證，攻城器械的規模越做越大，投石機與火藥器具把圍城戰的節奏整個改寫；而促成這一切變化的那件蒙古弓，則從頭到尾都是帝國野戰的主幹。整場戰爭沒有分出全盤的輸贏，卻把帝國的方向定了下來：往東，入主中原；往西，分而治之。
resultEn: The result was a Kublai victory, though a dirty one. The defeat at the Khere River had not broken him; on the contrary it taught him that the tribes and the Chinese lands had to be used together. Ariq Böke, in a favourable position, declined to pursue, and so turned a war that could have been decided quickly into four years of attrition, until in the west he lost all his following to the pressure of the Kipchak and Chagatai peoples. In 1264 Ariq Böke sent envoys to ask for terms and submitted from Nama in the western regions; the court treated him generously, and he died of illness in 1265. The dispute over the khanship was over, and Kublai became the sole Great Khan of the Mongol empire — but the empire behind that single title had already split into four: the southern steppe and the Chinese lands in the hands of the Yuan court, while the Kipchak, Chagatai and Ögedeid houses each held a quarter of their own and owed one another nothing. As for the weapons, these four years were a large-scale practical examination. The efficiency of the crossbow at both ends of an assault or a defence was tested again and again, siege equipment grew in scale, and the trebuchet together with powder devices rewrote the tempo of the siege. The Mongol bow, which made all of this change possible, remained the backbone of the empire's field warfare from beginning to end. The war as a whole decided nothing outright, but it fixed the direction of the empire: eastward to rule the Central Plain, and westward to divide and to rule.
